title: Accelerator Module Overview
description: Explains Windows-only accelerator handling and PRIMARY_MODIFIER constant.
body: OpenKaava ships on Windows only, so keystroke modifiers and checks have one answer: Ctrl and ctrlKey. This module gives PRIMARY_MODIFIER and hasPrimaryModifier as the single place these are defined, replacing the ⌘K the search slot used to draw and the e.metaKey || two listeners used to test. menus.ts and shortcuts.ts keep their accelerators as literals, being data tables.
